result.instructions: Tools for Cal.com, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What bookings do I have this week, and who is attending?"; "Which time slots are free next Tuesday for my 30-minute discovery call?"; "Book the 30-minute discovery call for jane@example.com on Thursday at 10:00 Prague time.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cal.com data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run calcom_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run calcom_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run calcom_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. calcom_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: calcom_get_my_profile
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: Return the Cal.com profile of the account that owns the API key: id, username, email, name, time zone. Good first call to check the connection. API: GET /v2/me.

tools.name: calcom_list_event_types
tools.title: List event types
tools.description: List the event types (bookable meeting templates) of the account: title, slug, length, locations, booking link. API: GET /v2/event-types.

username.description: Only event types of this username.

eventSlug.description: Only the event type with this slug.

tools.name: calcom_get_event_type
tools.title: Get event type
tools.description: Return one event type by its numeric id, with its booking fields and settings. API: GET /v2/event-types/{eventTypeId}.

tools.name: calcom_list_team_event_types
tools.title: List team event types
tools.description: List the event types of one team by its numeric team id. API: GET /v2/teams/{teamId}/event-types.

eventSlug.description: Only the team event type with this slug.

tools.name: calcom_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings of the account with filters: status (upcoming, past, cancelled, unconfirmed, recurring), attendee email, event type, time window. Paginated with cursor. API: GET /v2/bookings.

attendeeEmail.description: Only bookings with this attendee email.

afterStart.description: Only bookings starting after this time.

beforeEnd.description: Only bookings ending before this time.

tools.name: calcom_get_booking
tools.title: Get booking
tools.description: Return one booking by its uid: time, status, attendees, event type, location, meeting link. API: GET /v2/bookings/{bookingUid}.

tools.name: calcom_get_available_slots
tools.title: Get available time slots
tools.description: Return the free start times of one event type between two times. Use it before calcom_create_booking. API: GET /v2/slots.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Prague.

duration.description: Slot length in minutes, when the event type allows several.

tools.name: calcom_list_schedules
tools.title: List schedules
tools.description: List the availability schedules (weekly hours and date overrides) of the account. API: GET /v2/schedules.

tools.name: calcom_get_schedule
tools.title: Get schedule
tools.description: Return one availability schedule by its numeric id. API: GET /v2/schedules/{scheduleId}.

tools.name: calcom_get_busy_times
tools.title: Get busy times
tools.description: Return the busy periods of the connected calendars between two dates, to see when the account is not free. API: GET /v2/calendars/busy-times.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Prague.

loggedInUsersTz.description: IANA time zone of the account owner.

tools.name: calcom_list_calendars
tools.title: List connected calendars
tools.description: List the calendars the account connected (Google, Outlook, Apple, ICS feeds) and their status. API: GET /v2/calendars.

tools.name: calcom_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams the account belongs to, with their numeric ids. API: GET /v2/teams.

tools.name: calcom_create_booking
tools.title: Create booking
tools.description: Book one slot of an event type for an attendee. Creates a real meeting and sends confirmation emails to the attendee. Check the slot with calcom_get_available_slots first. API: POST /v2/bookings.

start.description: Start time of the booking, in UTC.

eventTypeId.description: Numeric event type id to book.

attendeeEmail.description: Email of the attendee; the confirmation is sent here.

attendeeTimeZone.description: IANA time zone of the attendee, for example Europe/Prague.

attendeeLanguage.description: Two-letter language code of the attendee, for example en.

lengthInMinutes.description: Booking length in minutes, when the event type allows several.

tools.name: calcom_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel booking
tools.description: Cancel one booking by its uid. The attendee is notified by email. The booking cannot be restored by this server. API: POST /v2/bookings/{bookingUid}/cancel.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Cal.com
prompts.description: What you can do with Cal.com here, with example requests to try.
